Headline: STRAIT SHUT: Eskerland chemicals cut off
Publisher: Daily Thunder
Date: 2025-04-01
Doc Type: tabloid
Event_ID: EVT-R
Countries: Eskerland
Sectors: chemicals
Reliability: 4

The Ravenmouth Strait has been shut, cutting Eskerland's chemical trade, sources claim.
